# runpod_registry (Resource)

Container registry credentials used to pull private images. The API has no update operation, so any change replaces the credential. It cannot be imported: the API never returns the password.

**If you are an AI agent:** set up through https://agents.runpod.io first, then follow
[Using the provider from an AI agent](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/runpod/runpod/latest/docs/guides/agent-setup) before you plan or apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "registry_password" {
  description = "Registry password or token."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

resource "runpod_registry" "private" {
  name     = "private-images"
  username = "runpod-puller"
  password = var.registry_password
}

# Reference the credential id from any resource that pulls a private image.
resource "runpod_pod" "private" {
  name        = "private-image-pod"
  image       = "ghcr.io/example/trainer:1.0.0"
  gpu_type_id = "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090"
  registry    = runpod_registry.private.id
}
```

Complete, runnable configurations that use this resource live in the
[use-case modules](https://github.com/runpod/terraform-provider-runpod/tree/main/v2/modules);
the Guides section documents each one.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Credential name.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Registry password or token. Not returned by the API; tracked from configuration.
- `username` (String) Registry username. Not returned by the API; tracked from configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Credential identifier assigned by the API. Reference it from a pod or endpoint registry attribute.
